name: Fire
description: Energy, forges, destruction, purification.

name: Water
description: Flow, cleansing, chemistry.

name: Earth
description: Stone, ore, soil, structure.

name: Air
description: Breath, wind, sound, smoke.

name: Light
description: Truth, order, faith.

name: Life
description: Growth, blood, healing, beasts.

name: Shadow
description: Secrets, concealment, fear.

name: Death
description: Decay, endings, the dead.

name: Mud
description: Wet ground, heavy and patient.

name: Steam
description: Water driven to fury by heat.

name: Metal
description: Ore drawn out of stone by flame.

name: Tree
description: Living wood rooted in the ground.

name: Smoke
description: What wood leaves in the air when it burns.

name: Mind
description: Breath that has learned to think.

name: Sand
description: Stone, worn down to grit. It gets into everything and stays.

name: Sound
description: Air shaken over water. Felt in the teeth before it is heard.

name: Salt
description: What the boiling leaves on the pan. Cheap, and taxed anyway.

name: Glass
description: Sand that went through the furnace and came out brittle. It cuts the hand that hurries.

name: Iron
description: Grey, honest metal. It rusts the moment you stop watching it.

name: Silver
description: Pale metal that takes a shine and a stamp. The church counts every ounce.

name: Animal
description: Something that breathes and bolts. Warm, wary, and worth more in parts.

name: Blood
description: Warm when given, tacky when kept. Nobody asks whose.

name: Spirits
description: Clear, sharp, and strong enough to strip a kettle. Sold as medicine.

name: Sulfur
description: Yellow powder with a smell like a struck match in a cellar. It clings to the fingers for days.

name: Crystal
description: Clear stone that holds the light a moment too long. Dealers wrap it in felt.

name: Gold
description: Soft, heavy, and never where the ledger says it is.

name: Bat
description: A leather scrap with teeth. It hunts by the sound of its own voice.

name: Food
description: Bread, mostly. Enough to keep the hands working.

name: Feather
description: Light, hollow, and shed without complaint. It remembers the air.

name: Rotted leaves
description: Black mulch from the bottom of the heap. Sweet smell, wet hands.

name: Bone dust
description: Ground fine and pale. The miller does not say what went under the stone.

name: Bat guano
description: Scraped from cave floors by people paid too little. Rich, dry, and eager to burn.

name: Person
description: Clay that got up and started owing money.

name: Forge
description: A fire fed until iron gives in. It eats coal and forearms.

name: Herb
description: What grows low where the ground stays wet. Bitter, mostly, and worth more dried.

name: Wilds
description: Where the trees and the beasts are left to it. No roads, no tithes, no witnesses.

name: Crown
description: Gold set with stones, heavier than it looks. Everyone near it stands very straight.

name: Tea
description: Dried leaf and hot water. The cheapest comfort in the city, and the only one not taxed yet.

name: Spellbook
description: A tome-type focus. Pages that hold a working still.
